headline: Equippp Social Impact files SEBI depository compliance certificate for September quarter
hook: Routine compliance update for Equippp Social Impact
summary: Equippp Social Impact Technologies has submitted its depository compliance certificate to SEBI for the quarter ended September. Such procedural filings are mandatory for listed companies to maintain regulatory compliance. The filing contains routine administrative data rather than financial performance metrics. Indian retail investors holding the stock see no immediate impact on valuation from this procedural disclosure.
why_it_matters: No material impact on share price or company financials.

headline: Equippp Social Impact Technologies submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Equippp Social Impact Technologies Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The company provided the mandatory compliance filings to the stock exchanges. Retail investors tracking routine corporate governance and shareholder resolutions can note the completion of the AGM process. This is a standard regulatory filing with no immediate financial impact on the company's stock price.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate governance filing with no direct impact on stock price.
